ModMetaData.name: ManyWaters
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Generic water-effects engine (engine promoted from RUT RiverSteam per R10: ManyWaters gathers all water effects/types — steaming, boiling, etc. — as they land). Currently ships the animated river-steam ambience: periodic "Steam" FleckDef puffs off river cells, reusing vanilla's own TerrainDef.IsRiver test — a pure ambience feature, no gameplay effect. Biome-agnostic: a biome opts in by carrying a `RiverSteamHook.RiverSteamBiomeExtension` modExtension (which also carries the tuning — fleck, puff interval, scale, drift), and this engine names no biome of its own (MANYWATERS_GENERIC_SPLIT_1). Campaign-specific wiring lives in RimUtinni: UtinniPatches — Patches/ManyWaters_RiverSteam_Ashkarr.xml puts the extension on ZBiome_Grasslands (the Pyrelands).
SAND_SWIMMERS_MOD_1 (2026-09-09) added `RM_DeepSand`, an impassable, fishable sand terrain built the same way vanilla deep water is (the "Water" tag, not a new type) — Defs/TerrainDefs/RM_DeepSand.xml. Generic like everything else here: it names no biome and carries no fish of its own. The Star-Wars-flavored catch/predator/prize family lives in RimStarWars: SWBestiary, and the Ash'karr biome wiring (which BiomeDef actually offers that fish list) lives in RimUtinni: UtinniPatches.
